criteria.criterion: Law enforcement has a reasonable belief that an abduction occurred
criteria.basis: A witness saw the child taken into a vehicle by an adult the family does not know.

criteria.criterion: The child is in imminent danger of serious bodily injury or death
criteria.basis: No threat is known. The commander treats the unknown adult as the basis for danger.

criteria.criterion: There is enough descriptive information to issue an alert
criteria.basis: Vehicle description and direction of travel from the witness.

criteria.criterion: The child’s name and critical data, including the Child Abduction flag, are entered in the national crime information database

decision.outcome: Issue the alert for Marston and Harlan counties

fields.stateNote: The five criteria are Justice Department recommendations. This state’s criteria govern.

alertText.headline: AMBER Alert: Marston County
alertText.body: Child, age 7, taken from the 400 block of Mill Street at about 1:50 p.m. Last seen in a dark blue minivan heading east. If you see the vehicle, call 911. Do not approach it.

fields.stateNote: Alert text is sent by the state coordinator on the sheriff’s request.
